provenance.framework: FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
provenance.citation: Wilkinson, M. D. et al. (2016). Scientific Data 3, 160018.
provenance.note: The principles are the published framework. The operational checks below are this tool's interpretation of them for offline personal and lab archives — they are not part of the published standard, and are versioned separately so a changed interpretation is a data change.

scoring.note: Each criterion is pass, fail, or not-applicable. A score is the share of applicable criteria passed, weighted. Criteria marked blocking make the collection's grade at most 'incomplete' however well it scores elsewhere.

criteria.title: Globally unique and persistent identifiers
criteria.gap: The collection has no persistent local identifier, so nothing can refer to it stably.
criteria.remedy: A local_pid is assigned on confirmation; this should never fail, and failing means the row was created outside the confirmation path.

criteria.title: Content addressed by checksum
criteria.gap: Some content has no hash, so it has no permanent name independent of its path.
criteria.remedy: Run a hash pass. Files whose size is unique in the catalog are never opened and cannot be hashed; those are excluded from the denominator.

criteria.title: Rich metadata
criteria.gap: Core descriptive fields are empty, so the collection cannot be understood by anyone who did not create it.
criteria.remedy: Fill title, description, creators, contact and data type.

criteria.title: Metadata explicitly references the data
criteria.gap: No manifest binds the identifier to checksums, paths and holding drives.
criteria.remedy: Export the collection; the bundle writes that binding (arrives with M8).

criteria.title: Indexed and searchable
criteria.gap: The content is not in a searchable index.
criteria.remedy: Content in the catalog is searchable by name, size, date, drive and collection; this fails only for content outside the catalogued scope.

criteria.title: Retrievable by identifier
criteria.gap: The collection cannot be located: no live copy is recorded on any known drive.
criteria.remedy: Attach the drive and rescan, or record where the media is shelved.

criteria.title: Metadata persists when data does not
criteria.gap: Descriptions and checksums would not survive the loss of the media.
criteria.remedy: The catalog tombstones vanished files rather than deleting their rows, so this passes by construction.

criteria.title: Formal, shared representation
criteria.gap: The collection has no machine-readable description in a shared format.
criteria.remedy: RO-Crate and DataCite export arrive with M8.

criteria.title: Controlled vocabularies
criteria.gap: Data type or license is free text rather than a controlled term, so it cannot be compared or aggregated.
criteria.remedy: Choose a data type and licence from the shipped vocabularies.

criteria.title: Qualified references to other data
criteria.gap: No typed relations to other collections or external records.
criteria.remedy: Where version sets were detected, an IsVersionOf relation is proposed for confirmation.

criteria.title: Accurate and relevant attributes
criteria.gap: Attributes a reuser would need are missing.
criteria.remedy: Fill description, data type, project and retention note.

criteria.title: Clear and accessible licence
criteria.gap: No licence is recorded. Unlicensed data is not reusable by anyone else, whatever else is in place.
criteria.remedy: Set a licence from the shipped vocabulary. For material that genuinely must not be shared, record that explicitly rather than leaving it blank.

criteria.title: Provenance
criteria.gap: No scan history or fixity record exists for this content.
criteria.remedy: Scan history is recorded automatically; run a verify pass to add fixity events.

criteria.title: Domain-relevant community standards
criteria.gap: A substantial share of the collection is in formats at risk of becoming unreadable.
criteria.remedy: Consider open preservation formats for the at-risk share. This is a recommendation only — Drive Fusion never converts anything.
